study.question: Does replacing the redundant fifth match summary with task-conditioned within-block feedback/value covariance improve validation click AUC, and is any gain attributable to actual event alignment and task-specific membership rather than generic feedback summaries?
study.hypothesis: Observed in candidate.py: _compress_both/_compress_unique_support collapse cart/fav/buy membership into one union; primary block means and action means do not preserve arbitrary item-by-feedback covariance, while the fifth channel is a gated duplicate target-match direction. At fixed learned width, a normalized centered summary of each task historical membership against event values may recover complementary covariance for task-specific adapters and context/history products. Typed aligned should exceed typed rotated and union aligned, with a positive scope-by-alignment interaction and a useful gain over the historical parent. Recent unsuccessful gradient perturbations motivate a forward representation test; they do not refute gradient methods generally.

nearest_work.difference: DIN primary text describes target-conditioned local activation. Keep inherited target scorer; replace a single compressed detail with typed feedback/value covariance, not a reproduction of DIN or a novel attention claim.

Pinned forward lines123..170 initialize task sequence hubs by task-specific action-mask averages, then perform repeated hub exchange. Inherit the idea of task-mask conditioning only: center within blocks to isolate covariance and use one capacity-preserving detail replacement, with no hub exchange, added learned projection or claim against original INFNet. Original paper provenance exists but content unavailable.

Inherit full incumbent; replace fifth detail for all four tasks. Existing target-match/ordinal/quadratic summaries, source-gradient gates, block nonlinear projections and buy-summary VJP remain. Local history does not establish external priority.

inherited_components: Frozen encoded fields,labels,100-event prefixes and released task masks
All incumbent embeddings,uniform/feedback block compression,folded support Dice scorer,towers and normalization buffers
First four match/ordinal/quadratic details and existing fifth computation retained for work accounting
Task residual adapters,context/history product,RMS normalization,block-local projection,native click/cart/fav and inherited buy summary VJP
Auxiliary item/action/scorer ownership and tower-versus-adapter context gates; initialization/RNG and host training recipe
study.proposed_difference: Replace the fifth detail at its two downstream consumers with a centered binary-feedback/value contraction: within each block c=m-valid*sum(m)/count; normalize c across all blocks to the inherited local-ordinal coefficient norm; contract masked values and divide by sqrt(total count). Task factor selects the task historical mask versus union of all four masks. Alignment factor uses actual membership versus deterministic half-valid-rank rotation within each block. No added modules/state/parameters. All four banks compute in each variant. Current labels never route forward computation.
predictions: typed_aligned full-validation click AUC exceeds typed_rotated and union_aligned, and exceeds incumbent0.668531811; all four tasks and cost are reported even if click worsens.

Scope-by-alignment interaction (typed_aligned-typed_rotated)-(union_aligned-union_rotated) is positive if matching feedback identity to prediction task adds useful alignment beyond generic union covariance.

At common weights, aligned versus rotated coefficients preserve within-block membership counts/zero-sums/support and global coefficient norm but can distinguish histories with equal marginal block item and action averages and different item-feedback pairing. No difference is predicted in homogeneous or singleton blocks.
Learned parameter count stays32192421; training/inference arithmetic and memory can increase. Any efficiency claim requires actual measured quality-cost comparison.
falsifiers: If typed_aligned fails to exceed parent, useful improvement is unsupported for this replacement; losing the duplicated match feature remains an alternative, not a general mechanism refutation.

If typed_aligned does not exceed its rotated control, actual event alignment is unsupported; if it does not exceed union_aligned or the interaction is nonpositive, task-specific advantage is unsupported.
An advantage disappearing under authorized paired-seed repetition or user-cluster uncertainty is preliminary selection noise; no statistical significance follows from this one-seed factorial.

Mask leakage,current-label access,changed parameter/RNG ownership,nonfinite execution or failed coefficient/gradient checks invalidate interpretation rather than count as negative scientific evidence.
alternative_explanations: Replacement removes useful match duplication and changes summary/parameter-gradient scale despite coefficient norm matching.
Task versus union support and prevalence differ; the two-factor interaction does not isolate identity from rarity without further support-matched or cyclic-task controls.
Rotation preserves binary counts but changes association with target matches and recency as well as item/value covariance, and may be identical on some histories.
Action embedding block averages already retain marginal feedback information; the new detail may provide easier optimization rather than previously inaccessible information.
Any click gain can combine direct click representation changes with auxiliary context transfer and shared dense clipping; auxiliary gradients into item/action/scorer remain blocked.
Many adaptively chosen validation trials and one seed can yield selection noise; native buy VJP gain is only0.000004943.
Offline released delayed-feedback visibility and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics limit transfer; no production causal claim.

variants.name: typed_aligned
variants.note:
feedback_detail_scope=task; feedback_detail_alignment=aligned. Unmeasured prospective representation replacement. Replace only the fifth value-width detail supplied to each task residual adapter and history projection; preserve the first four summaries, all compression/scorer/tower operations, parameters, initialization, Dice state, gradient ownership, custom buy-summary VJP, loss and frozen host recipe. Each task uses its own released historical feedback mask or the OR of all four masks. Center binary membership within each 10-event temporal block, normalize its whole-history coefficient L2 norm to the inherited within-block ordinal coefficient norm, contract against masked item/action values, and divide by sqrt(valid event count). Zero-variance membership has zero coefficients. Rotated membership is shifted by half the number of valid positions within each block, preserving membership counts, empty/homogeneous support, coefficient sums and coefficient L2 norm; actual value-summary norms and gradients need not match. All task/union and aligned/rotated coefficient banks and contractions execute in every cell. No current labels, target actions, raw timestamps, external IDs or new state enter. Auxiliary new details are detached exactly like inherited item/action details. Expected inherited parameters: 32192421 total,31793216 embedding,399205 dense; host must verify. Compared with the historical parent this removes a useful duplicated match direction, so only the matched rotated and union controls identify information alignment/task conditioning, and a parent loss alone cannot refute feedback covariance generally.
Host prerequisites: verify frozen protocol/data/loader/source identities and prior readiness receipts; raw data and tensor execution are absent locally. Require four finite [B,1] probabilities, default unweighted four-BCE and finite FP32/BF16 backward. Test empty, singleton, homogeneous, full, partial and noncontiguous masks, overlapping multi-action membership, all 24 task-label orders with masks reordered consistently, invalid-value/ID/membership perturbation invariance, unknown current-action boundary, sparse repeated-ID accumulation, construction/RNG identity, learned/state shapes and checkpoint/device roundtrip. Verify centered coefficients sum to zero per block, aligned/rotated counts/support/norm identity, vanishing singleton/homogeneous coefficients, finite near-zero norms, half-rotation mapping by valid rank, invariance to adding a block-constant value vector, and identical results for task/union cells when memberships are identical. Rotated masks can coincide with original masks; report the degenerate fraction if authorized diagnostics permit. Source parent parity holds for inherited tensors/operators and initial zero-correction predictions; full trained prediction/gradient parity is neither expected nor required. Existing buy surrogate is first-order only; do not require finite-difference gradcheck for that intentionally modified VJP.
